rep.angle: lead with a recent hiring push you noticed
rep.name: Maya

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Sam Whitfield. I have fifteen minutes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Sam, I noticed Northwind’s recent hiring push. HyperSale gives those reps realistic AI buyer practice and quote-backed scoring before they reach prospects.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Why is this worth forty-eight thousand dollars?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: The key is realistic practice, quote-backed scoring, and week-by-week manager visibility, so problems surface before quota time. Is faster ramping a priority?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, if you can quantify it. How many weeks do you expect to cut from ramp, and what evidence supports that?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: It varies by team, so I can’t responsibly promise weeks without your baseline; our 30-day pilot measures gains through quote-backed scores. Fair?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Fair, but I won’t approve forty-eight thousand on a hypothesis. What does the pilot cost, what ramp-time threshold defines success, and can you bring the annual price below thirty-five thousand?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I can price a one-team pilot and set the success threshold against baseline; under $35,000 requires reduced scope. Can we schedule a business-case review?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: What date? Come prepared with the pilot cost, a quantified ramp-time threshold, and your best annual price for all forty reps below thirty-five thousand.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How about Thursday at 2 p.m.? I’ll bring pilot pricing, a measurable ramp threshold, and an all-40-rep option below $35,000 tied to term.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Thursday at 2 p.m. works. Bring your best one-year price for all forty reps below $35,000, not just a multi-year discount, and quantify the ramp savings. Send me the business case and we'll take it from there.
